simulators: PenSimPy corrected native port of IndPenSim
data_protocol.scoring: Separate product/indicator normalized absolute forecast errors; paired objective change versus keep; finite-grid regret.
data_protocol.prediction_target: Terminal product concentration and process indicator under KEEP, even when choosing another action.

objective.pensim: Maximize concentration at96h g/L: partial-process endpoint, NOT full-batch optimization, yield or economics.
objective.mab: Maximize integrated separator product outflow mg during the post-decision horizon; NOT downstream recovery.

data_protocol.transfer_scope: Same simulated geometry/strain; receiving aeration or balanced-flow capability changes. No receiving observations. This is recipe transfer under changed operating limits, NOT validated site transfer or scale-up.
data_protocol.common_information: Identical source history, permitted receiving history, nominal equations, specifications, actions and source-derived calibration. B alone can execute the nominal forward-model tool.
data_protocol.nominal_model: Published fixed nominal initialization (no SMPL random perturbations), PenSim seed0 known parameters with future disturbances disabled. Product multiplicative and indicator additive correction using completed source endpoint only.
data_protocol.boundary: Tool outputs are nominal predictions, not evaluator replay. Realization seed, receiving futures and action outcomes remain evaluator-only.
known_limits: Small inspected development pilot; no untouched holdout or statistical power.
Full230h PenSimPy gate failed before this bounded96h design; this is a disclosed development response, not a successful full-batch result.
Forward tool and evaluator share model equations; this is not independent scientific validation.
Ideal synthetic process observations; no validated human effort or real batches saved.
PenSim retains upstream positivity/DO switches; floor events are reported.
SMPL uses upstream subsystem only; no downstream quality, oxygen-transfer or mixing-gradient model.
No manufacturing safety or GMP qualification is claimed.

native_build.build_only_change: Use installed Boost headers and pybind11; omit unused OpenMP build dependency.
